description: Save a reusable payment method (card token, bank account, wallet) against a Rapyd customer. Returns a payment_method id (pmt_xxx) you can pass to create_payment.payment_method.id for subsequent charges — e.g. one-click checkout or subscription billing.

address.description: Optional billing address object (name, line_1, city, country, zip, ...)

customer.description: Rapyd customer id (cus_xxx) the method will attach to

fields.description: Method-specific fields — e.g. { number, expiration_month, expiration_year, cvv, name } for cards

name: create_payment_method
